primary.title: Opening multiple demat or mutual fund accounts? SEBI simplifies KYC norms: 8 key changes for investors from 24 December
primary.summary: SEBI has announced eight changes to simplify the KYC process for investors opening demat, trading and mutual fund accounts with multiple intermediaries. The new rules will reduce paperwork and avoid repeated verification. Here's what changes from 24 December.
